title: Document the pre-commit secrets-scan setup and no-bypass rule in the db-models README
description: Add a README.md at the root of applications/db-models/repos/onfinance-db-model-master (the repo currently tracks no README) with a contributor setup section: run pre-commit install after cloning so the gitleaks hook from task 1 runs on every commit, why it exists (sdlc/policy.json secretsManagement scanning gate and the SEBI CSCRF PR.IP.S2 system development life cycle), and a rule that bypassing the hook with --no-verify or SKIP=gitleaks is not permitted, with escalation to the CISO for genuine false positives. Note that the blocking CI-side gitleaks job lands with the repo's CI work tracked under finding fnd_01M2KGVJJ2AXNAXRE08PZ2Z7YP and is out of scope here. Constraints: documentation only, no new scripts, CI or runtime change; sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess defines no deploymentWindows and no change freeze applies.
acceptanceCriteria: A README.md is tracked at the repo root and its setup section instructs contributors to run pre-commit install after cloning
The README states that the gitleaks hook runs on every commit at the blocking low threshold and that --no-verify or SKIP=gitleaks bypasses are not permitted, naming the CISO as the escalation point
The README cites SEBI CSCRF 2024 PR.IP.S2 as the requirement the hook implements

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer reads the merged README.md diff on master and checks the setup and no-bypass sections against sdlc/policy.json ciGates (secrets: gitleaks, blocking, minSeverityToBlock low) and secretsManagement.scanningInCi. Expected result: both sections exist and accurately quote the pre-commit install step, the blocking low threshold and the no-bypass rule.

rootCause.description: The repository never carried contributor documentation for secrets hygiene, so even a correct hook would not be installed by cloners and the missing control could silently regress.
